plain_text:
Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, Ronald Colman is credited on 66 distinct recordings across 6 programs from 1941-01-13 through 1953-11-23. Documented roles include performer on 66 recordings and writer on 1 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are The Halls of Ivy (performer on 54 recordings and writer on 1 recording; 54 distinct recordings), Lux Radio Theatre (performer on 7 recordings; 7 distinct recordings), Academy Award Theater (performer on 2 recordings; 2 distinct recordings), Encore Theater (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording), Screen Directors Playhouse (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording), and Screen Guild Theater (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording).

Documented character portrayals include Dr. William Todhunter Hall (54 portrayals).
